result.instructions: Tools for Zenkit, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which lists are in my Zenkit workspaces?"; "Find every entry that mentions 'invoice' and show the list each one is in."; "What fields does my Zenkit project list have?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Zenkit data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run zenkit_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run zenkit_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run zenkit_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. zenkit_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: zenkit_get_current_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: Get the Zenkit user that owns the API key: name, username, locale, timezone and e-mail addresses. Good first call to confirm the connection. Zenkit API: GET /api/v1/users/me.

tools.name: zenkit_list_workspaces
tools.title: List workspaces with lists
tools.description: List the workspaces the user can access, each with its lists (collections). Use the returned list shortId or id in other tools. Zenkit API: GET /api/v1/users/me/workspacesWithLists.

tools.name: zenkit_get_workspace
tools.title: Get a workspace
tools.description: Get one workspace by its id, shortId or uuid: name, description and creation data. Zenkit API: GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspaceAllId}.

workspace_all_id.description: Workspace id, shortId or uuid (from zenkit_list_workspaces).

tools.name: zenkit_get_list
tools.title: Get a list
tools.description: Get one list (collection) by its shortId: name, item name, workspace id and visibility. Zenkit API: GET /api/v1/lists/{listShortId}.

tools.name: zenkit_get_list_elements
tools.title: Get list fields
tools.description: Get all fields (elements) of a list: name, type category, sort order and visibility. Call this before reading entries, to learn the field names. Zenkit API: GET /api/v1/lists/{listAllId}/elements.

list_all_id.description: The list id, shortId or uuid.

tools.name: zenkit_get_list_users
tools.title: Get list members
tools.description: Get the users who have access to a list, with their roles. Zenkit API: GET /api/v1/lists/{listAllId}/users.

list_all_id.description: The list id, shortId or uuid.

tools.name: zenkit_get_list_activities
tools.title: Get list activities
tools.description: Get recent activities (changes, comments) in one list, newest first, with paging. Zenkit API: GET /api/v1/lists/{listAllId}/activities.

list_all_id.description: The list id, shortId or uuid.

tools.name: zenkit_get_entry
tools.title: Get a list entry
tools.description: Get one entry (item) of a list by its ids: the field values, checklists and timestamps. Zenkit API: GET /api/v1/lists/{listAllId}/entries/{listEntryAllId}.

list_all_id.description: The list id, shortId or uuid.

list_entry_all_id.description: The entry id, shortId or uuid (from zenkit_search_entries).

tools.name: zenkit_search_entries
tools.title: Search entries
tools.description: Search list entries (items) across all lists the user can access, by text. Returns matching entries; set include_related_lists to also get the lists they belong to. Zenkit API: GET /api/v1/entries/search.

include_related_lists.description: true = include the lists the matches belong to.
